response_raw:
Coffee_Delivery
agents:
	humans: Employee
	robots: CoffeeRobot
locations: coffee_room, office004
resources: coffee
CoffeeRobot:
	1: moveTo coffee_room
	2: pick coffee if time(30) else stop
	3: moveTo office004
	4: deposit coffee if time(20) else stop
	5: stop
Employee:
	1: stop
success: position(CoffeeRobot, office004) && possess(CoffeeRobot, coffee)
failure: time(700) && !position(CoffeeRobot, office004)
